investment_theses.thesis: BTC outperforms SPY through midterms (late June 2026) as Trump Iran no-strike pledge reduces geopolitical tail risk while consumer debt stress supports safe-haven flows.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Trump Iran pledge removes strike risk, BTC bears face liquidation pressure near $82.5k.
CNBC: Consumer debt deterioration (worst signal since Great Recession) signals deflationary shock and flight to crypto.
CoinDesk: BTC perp funding rates show retail long positioning; liquidation cascade ready to trigger.
investment_theses.counter_view: If Hurricane Isaias refinery damage worsens or Trump-Putin diesel deal stalls, inflation fears resurface and macro investors rotate into cyclicals (energy, commodities), hammering BTC relative to SPY.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC/USD via spot (Kraken/Binance) or perpetuals; Short SPY or use BTC/SPY ratio product (e.g., Deribit synthetic).

investment_theses.thesis: High-yield credit spreads widen further (flashing yellow becomes red) through summer 2026; outperform via short HYG/long TLT (high-yield bond ETF vs. long-duration Treasury ETF).
supporting_signals: CNBC: Junk bond spreads already widening; researchers confirm debt payment deterioration not seen since Great Recession.
CNBC: Americans' wealth disparities narrowing but debt-servicing ability collapsing (negative financial health shift).
Macro: Hurricane Isaias + refinery destruction + midterm uncertainty creates corporate cash flow stress.
investment_theses.counter_view: If Trump-Putin diesel deal succeeds in durably lowering energy costs and tax cuts stimulate growth, high-yield credit recovers. Fed cuts too aggressively and crushes spreads via liquidity surge.
investment_theses.expression: Short HYG (iShares High Yield Bond ETF) or long TLT (iShares 20+ Year Treasury ETF) or long LQD/short HYG pair trade.

investment_theses.thesis: Semiconductor sector (SMH, NVDA, MU, SOXL) consolidates mid-year after bear short buildup; MU outperforms NVDA on memory supply recovery, creating relative value opportunity.

Macro: AI capex cycle matures; memory (MU's core) becomes supply-constrained, reversing cycle lows.
Risk: Midterm election outcome (late June) and Fed policy signals in June meeting could reset valuation.
investment_theses.counter_view: If recession fears spike (consumer debt data), datacenter spending pullback accelerates and both NVDA and MU roll over. Tech broadens repricing lower through Q3.
investment_theses.expression: Long MU (Micron Technology) or SMH (Semiconductor ETF); hedge with short QQQ or NVDA specific short. Use 60-day call spreads (bullish skew on MU relative to NVDA).

investment_theses.thesis: DXY (U.S. Dollar Index) rises 2-3% into late June 2026 as fiscal/geopolitical uncertainty (Trump-Putin deal, midterm outcomes) drives flight-to-safety demand despite Fed rate-cut pressure.
supporting_signals: BBC/CNBC: Trump-Putin diesel deal signals unpredictable foreign policy; geopolitical risk premiums should lift dollar.
CNBC: Fed pressure from Trump (Lisa Cook committee) creates policy uncertainty; hawkish hold by Powell likely before June midterm.
Macro: Refinery disruptions (Hurricane Isaias) create inflation wild card; Fed can't cut confidently.
investment_theses.counter_view: If Russian diesel floods U.S. markets and inflation falls faster than expected, Fed cuts 50+ bps by Q3 and DXY rolls over. Emerging markets rally, carry trades unwind.
investment_theses.expression: Long DXY spot or futures (NYBOT or via DBC proxy); long USD/EUR via FX forward or options. Use 90-day DXY call spreads (out-of-the-money).
